content:
lina: Final heads-up 10:30 UTC deploy for rwd-supermodel v3.2.0. Geo phased: US -> EU -> APAC. Window 23:30-03:30 UTC. Pin traffic to 3.2.0 while rolling.

lina: Canary plan is conservative: 3% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100% with 12m observation windows. EU will use a smaller step progression if warm pool stays low.

kevin: Add gating: automated stage rollback if error_rate > 3% (3m) OR p95 delta > 200ms (3m). If that hits, immediate action: pin to 3.1.x-stable and scale new pods to 0.

anya: Capacity snapshot:
US warm=96 reserved=320 active=224
EU warm=18 reserved=160 active=142 (note: scheduled infra maintenance 00:30-01:00 UTC)
APAC warm=40 reserved=120 active=80

sam: Noted. Because of EU maintenance we'll put a hard hold after US full and before EU canary. APAC to follow after EU completes.

ops-bot: Creating rollout job -> id=roll-2945612345
ops-bot: Queued command:
```
/deploy start --svc=rwd-supermodel --ver=3.2.0 --regions=us,eu,apac --slices=3,15,50,100 --hold-after=us_full --pin=true
```

lina: Release notes draft: "3.2.0 1: KV cache prefetch improvements, attention kernel tweak, safer memory path". Will attach after US canary green.

kevin: Oncall checklist:
- run /health and /predict smoke on representative payloads
- enable 5% trace sampling for new model
- set alert: error_rate > 3% (3m), p95 delta >200ms (3m), infra thermal warn -> abort

anya: EU warm pool risk: if warm < 15 GPUs at EU canary start we abort EU and fallback to pinned 3.1.4-quant variant. Marking maintenance window in schedule.

ops-bot: roll-2945612345: US canary started at 23:32 UTC (3% slice). Monitoring 12m.

sam: US canary smoke: /health OK, /predict latency stable. metrics: error 0.4%, p95 +8ms. QA running quick checks.

kevin: Observability hooked: p50/p95/p99 across routes, sample traces collecting. No anomalies after 6m.

ops-bot: roll-2945612345: US -> 15% slice complete.

lina: Proceeding to 50% after 12m if signals stay green.

ops-bot: roll-2945612345: US -> 50% -> 100% complete at 00:10 UTC. US region now pinned to 3.2.0.

sam: US full smoke passed. Logs look clean. Holding per plan before EU due to scheduled infra maintenance.

lina: Holding until EU maintenance window ends at 01:00 UTC. @anya please confirm warm pool after maintenance.

anya: EU maintenance running. Current warm=12 -> predicted post-maintenance ~26 in 18m. Will confirm 5m before resume.

ops-bot: Holdpoint created at after_us_full. Manual resume required: `/deploy resume roll-2945612345`

kevin: Reminder: thermal headroom monitor enabled. If any host shows GPU thermal throttle events during EU canary, we'll abort EU and route traffic to US/APAC mirrors.

lina: Support on standby, ops ticket #OPS-9188 created.

anya: Maintenance completed at 01:05 UTC. Warm pool now 28 GPUs. Proceed with EU canary but keep EU initial at 3% and extend hold to 18m per earlier risk discussion.

ops-bot: `/deploy resume roll-2945612345` -> EU canary starting (3%).

kevin: EU canary smoke: error 1.0%, p95 +30ms. No thermal warnings. QA running regional tests.

taylor: QA PASS for EU initial checks. Leaving heavier regression suite to run during the extended hold.

ops-bot: EU -> 15% after manual approval. Monitoring.

kevin: Mid-monitor report: EU error holds at 1.4%, p95 +45ms, trace samples show no memory leaks. Proceeding to 50% skipped; we'll jump to 30% instead to be extra cautious given the maintenance earlier.

lina: Agreed. Move EU to 30% then 60% then 100% with 12m windows.

ops-bot: roll-2945612345: EU progressed 30% -> 60% -> 100% over staged steps. No automated rollback triggered.

anya: APAC warm pool is stable at 40 GPUs. We'll schedule APAC canary 25m after EU full to allow global metrics to settle.

ops-bot: scheduling APAC start in 25m.

sam: Quick note: instrumented a temporary circuit-breaker so if cross-region error correlation > 0.7 we'll pause remaining slices.

ops-bot: APAC canary started (3% slice).

kevin: APAC canary smoke: error 0.7%, p95 +15ms. No GPU thermal events.

ops-bot: APAC -> 15% -> 50% -> 100% complete. roll-2945612345: rollout finished across all regions. Results: no auto-rollbacks, one brief p95 blip in US at 23:57 UTC (+60ms for ~90s) investigated as non-user impacting. Logs: /deploy/logs/roll-2945612345

lina: Thanks all. Attaching release notes and changelog to the release page. Will follow up with a short retrospective on the EU maintenance timing and whether we should avoid infra changes during major rollouts.

ops-bot: closing ticket #OPS-9188 - resolved, rollout success.

lina: Closing thread. If any postdeploy regressions show up, escalate to #incidents immediately.
